rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thank you for reaching out. I'm glad Halcyon Threshold came up in conversation. Unfortunately, I'm not able to provide an on-the-record quote this week due to a timing issue I'm working through. I hope to be in a better position soon. If you'd like to keep in touch for future pieces, I'd welcome that. Best of luck with your deadline. Best, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Politely declined the press interview (Tessa Brandt)

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Dear Corvid Institute team, Thank you for the invitation to sign the open letter on frontier training runs. I've read the text and appreciate the work you're doing. I'm not able to add my name as a public signatory by Wednesday due to timing constraints on my end. I hope this doesn't preclude participation in future efforts. I wish you success with this initiative. Best regards, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: open letter signing (Corvid Institute), since your HR situation isn't resolved yet

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you so much for reaching out — I really appreciate it. With five hours a week from someone with data analysis skills, here's something I've been thinking about: there's a gap in how well the public (and even policymakers) can track what's actually happening at the frontier of AI development. I'd love to explore building a simple, regularly-updated dataset or dashboard tracking key indicators — things like disclosed training compute, safety team sizes, audit results, or deployment timelines. If that sounds interesting to you, would you be up for a short call this week to scope it out? Or if you'd prefer, send me your thoughts by email and we can go from there. Either way, I'm grateful you want to contribute. Best, Morgan"
rows.quote: Engaged Priya Raman — Sent her a concrete project idea (the tracker) and invited a scoping call.
